items.note: Aggregate placeholder for webbing, water, rations and small kit until M2.5 itemises it; rifle, magazines, helmet and vest are separate items.
Empty magazine mass published. See docs/research/ballistics.md (values from search extracts of the cited pages).
1.0-1.25 kg, pistol and fragment protection (game value: 2.5 mm steel equivalent). See docs/research/squads.md.
About 7.5-8 kg; plates rated against rifle rounds (class given as Br5/Br6 depending on source), soft armour around them. Plate coverage of the chest is a game value. See docs/research/squads.md.

Under-barrel 40 mm grenade launcher, about 1.5 kg. The search tool declined these look-ups in the research session; values are from general published references as remembered and must be verified against a public source. Game abstraction.
100-round belt in its box (published belt length); box mass and tracer mix are game values. Links counted in the empty mass.
RPG-7V2 launcher with sight, about 6.3 kg (from memory of published figures). It cannot be fired yet: anti-tank weapons arrive with vehicles in M7.
PG-7VL rocket, about 2.6 kg (from memory of published figures). Not usable before M7.
Two litres of water in canteens or a bladder. Mass is a typical value, not sourced; part of the itemised load that replaces the placeholder.
One day of rations. Mass is a typical value, not sourced; part of the itemised load that replaces the placeholder.
Individual first-aid kit (tourniquet, dressings); used by the medical system in M10. Mass is a typical value, not sourced; part of the itemised load that replaces the placeholder.
Load-carrying vest or belt kit, pouches, small pack, weather clothing, tools. Mass is a typical value, not sourced; part of the itemised load that replaces the placeholder.
Night-vision goggle; used by sensors in M9. Mass is a typical value, not sourced; part of the itemised load that replaces the placeholder.
Section radio with battery, typical mass; the comms model does not read it yet (M14).
The BMP-2's fuel tank (M7): the charge is litres of diesel (0.84 kg per litre). The tank itself is part of the hull (mass 0). Capacity is a game value.
